references.text: This verse describes the calling of Levi, who is also known as Matthew, in a similar way to Matthew 9:9, where Jesus sees Levi at the tax booth and calls him to follow.
This verse tells how Jesus called Philip to follow Him, paralleling how He called Matthew in Matthew 9:9.
